about: INAO's variety names (as in the AOC specifications, without the colour code) that don't match a grape's name or alias by spelling: the grape they are. Checked against VIVC's synonyms. Names left out are distinct varieties WineLib has no grape for (Gamay de Bouze, Lledoner Pelut, Picardan...): shown as INAO names them, unlinked. Colour mutations (Grolleau Gris, Mauzac Rose...) go to their grape by varieties.py's rule, not listed here.
